scope: Add Venice, Damascus, Acre and Nassau to the original 14-city collection, then create Chinese editions of all 18 posters.

english_additions.title: VENICE
english_additions.subtitle: ASSASSIN'S CREED II
english_additions.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE premium vertical 4:5 high-detail miniature city panorama poster for an Assassin's Creed main-game city collection. Pure warm white backdrop, top 18 percent is an elegant editorial masthead with oversized black condensed uppercase city title, small game subtitle and period line, a delicate city-specific skyline silhouette. Lower area is a dense beautifully crafted realistic 3D historical city miniature, elevated oblique aerial perspective, continuous coherent urban fabric, on a complete thick dark rectangular display plinth with all front corners visible and white margins. Museum-quality architectural materials and tiny period inhabitants, convincing scale, crisp natural light with subtle atmospheric depth, restrained vivid colors, rich authentic details, clear landmark hierarchy. Compressed artistic geography, not an exact map. No collage panels, modern buildings, modern vehicles, football elements, sports crests, wooden plaques, watermarks, or extra words. This is an original historical city visualization inspired by the game setting, not a screenshot.
City title exactly "VENICE". Subtitle exactly "ASSASSIN'S CREED II". Period exactly "VENETIAN REPUBLIC · 1486". Subject: Late fifteenth-century Venice, broad sinuous Grand Canal and turquoise lagoon around a dense maze of red tile roofs, Venetian Gothic palazzi, small canals and stone footbridges. St Mark's Basilica with five recognizable domes, Doge's Palace pink-white patterned facade and loggias, St Mark's campanile and Piazza San Marco. A wooden Rialto bridge rather than the later stone arch version, long elegant gondolas and small wooden sailing vessels, striped mooring poles and waterside trading activity. Warm golden afternoon light, terracotta roofs, ivory marble and jade water. No Bridge of Sighs, Santa Maria della Salute, modern cruise ships, modern motorboats or modern skyline.

Use case: text-localization. Edit the supplied city miniature poster into a Simplified Chinese edition. The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET, not merely inspiration. Preserve the original city scene, all buildings and streets, terrain, water, vessels, people, lighting, colors, delicate skyline silhouette, small decorative emblem if present, dark plinth, viewpoint, composition and 4:5 canvas. Only replace the English masthead typography in the white top section with the following exact Chinese text:
Main large city title: "阿卡"
Smaller game subtitle: "刺客信条"
Small period line: "圣地 · 1191年"
Use exceptionally clean, correctly formed Simplified Chinese glyphs, bold modern black Chinese sans-serif for the large city name, refined readable Chinese type for the subtitle and period. Keep the hierarchy and premium editorial mood of the original, centered alignment, comfortable spacing. Fit all three lines with no crowding; leave a clear white margin above the main title, never cut characters at the edge. Remove the replaced English wording entirely, including tiny English period text; do not add translations in parentheses or any new text. Preserve existing thin rules and skyline ornament where possible, adjusting only within the masthead to fit Chinese text. No added plaques, borders, watermarks or redrawn city. Output a single finished Chinese poster at the same aspect ratio as the input.
